chk_agent_tasks_run_claim.name: chk_agent_tasks_run_claim
chk_agent_tasks_run_claim.value: ("agent_tasks"."status" = 'running' AND "agent_tasks"."run_claim_token" IS NOT NULL) OR ("agent_tasks"."status" <> 'running' AND "agent_tasks"."run_claim_token" IS NULL)

chk_ai_processing_consents_decision.name: chk_ai_processing_consents_decision
chk_ai_processing_consents_decision.value: "ai_processing_consents"."granted_at" IS NOT NULL OR "ai_processing_consents"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

chk_places_merge_target.name: chk_places_merge_target
chk_places_merge_target.value: ("places"."status" = 'merged' AND "places"."merged_into_place_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("places"."status" <> 'merged' AND "places"."merged_into_place_id" IS NULL)

chk_user_feedback_active_expiry.name: chk_user_feedback_active_expiry
chk_user_feedback_active_expiry.value: "user_feedback"."feedback_type" NOT IN ('appeal', 'supplement_request') OR "user_feedback"."status" NOT IN ('open', 'in_review') OR "user_feedback"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL
